text: ‘Governments are powerless to prevent the spread of global crime.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Developing countries are kept poor by a capitalist world system.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The hypodermic syringe model provides the best explanation of how the media influences
behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The new media has created more opportunities for individuals to challenge existing power
structures.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Women have no power within religious organisations.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The growth of new religious movements is evidence that secularisation has occurred.’ Evaluate
this view. [35]
